deterministic_tool_integration.method: Load each train/val task via ToolSession.from_visible using environment_file and query, run tool_demo.run_demo, require validation.valid

independent_regressions: Conflicting notification evidence remains inspectable without selecting a verified transaction
Unrelated order notification conflicts do not block current-order refund queries
Unrelated order notification conflicts do not invalidate current-order plans
Fully evidenced orders cannot claim fabricated missing references to justify review
Pending receipts are not allocated as successful receipts in the demo
limitations: No LLM is connected and no SFT trajectory or parameter training is completed
ToolSession loading restricts runtime files to train/val visible snapshots; a trusted held-out evaluation runner remains to be designed
API path restrictions and snapshot isolation are not an operating-system sandbox
Evidence lookup returns existing visible records only and does not obtain external bank/channel evidence
Call budgets and retry routing remain the responsibility of the future Agent orchestrator
